name: Featured - prod spotlight
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Featured - prod spotlight.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Show header
settings.how: Turn on “Show header” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Heading
settings.how: Enter the heading. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Subheading
settings.default: A curated row of high-priority products—perfect for promos, bundles, and best-sellers.
settings.how: Use the rich text editor for paragraphs, lists, emphasis, and links. Use descriptive link text and headings in a logical order.

settings.label: View all link
settings.how: Select a Shopify destination or paste a valid URL. Use a descriptive button or link label. Empty destinations usually hide the associated action.

settings.label: Background type
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for background type. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Background image
settings.how: Select or upload an image. Add descriptive alt text and set its focal point in Shopify Files. Check the crop on both desktop and mobile; the image does not change the original file.

settings.label: Background video
settings.how: Select a video uploaded to Shopify Files. Supply a clear poster image where offered. Leave autoplay off for content that needs sound.
